headline: DEPTH-2 (first test of gap#4 credit AT DEPTH -- all prior were single-layer). The coincidence-gated BDSP GENERALIZES through depth (gen-gap 0.024, 6/6) where feedback-alignment MEMORIZES (FA gap ~0.33). But both cap at the SAME held-out ceiling (BDSP 0.636 vs FA 0.633, oracle 0.974) -- the depth-scaling wall is CONSOLIDATED across FA AND BDSP, and the capacity lever is closed (higher lr destabilizes even the oracle). BDSP does not BEAT FA on held-out (0/6 by margin) but has a qualitatively BETTER profile: it generalizes cleanly instead of memorizing. Both recover the level-1 XOR latents partially (probe ~0.64) but neither the full depth-2 structure.
